subject: Request: Reciprocity & market-restrictions waiver for VanguardAI POC
messages:

To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Grier <tom.grier@vanguardai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot agreement terms — reciprocity & regional restriction ask

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Our legal team reviewed the standard pilot terms and asked for two items that are high-priority for us: a reciprocity clause that requires parity of pricing/terms if Redwood later offers any similar product to our competitors, and a short-term regional market restriction (6 months) preventing Redwood from signing exclusivity with other suppliers in our specific EU market segment while we're in pilot.

We're ready to move forward if Redwood can accept these two asks for the pilot POC. The pilot spend is modest (estimate $28k). If needed we can mark the terms as pilot-limited and non-binding beyond the POC.

Can you escalate for an executive waiver? Tom is looped for visibility.

Best,
Elena

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>

Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@vanguardai.com>, Tom Grier <tom.grier@vanguardai.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot agreement terms — reciprocity & regional restriction ask

Folks — forwarding VanguardAI's ask. Key points:
- Reciprocity / pricing parity clause (MFN-like) for future similar products
- 6-month regional restriction (no exclusivity in their EU segment during pilot)
- Pilot value ~ $28k, with potential expansion into a dedicated deployment next year

Why it's risky: MFN/reciprocity creates precedent across enterprise deals; the regional restriction is functionally an exclusivity carveout that could conflict with our marketplace/partner commitments. Customer is willing to limit to the POC term and mark non-binding post-POC.

Requesting deal-desk / exec review: recommend either (A) deny MFN but offer a narrow parity commitment scoped to the pilot SKU and timeboxed to the pilot period, plus a customer-favorable statement that we won't intentionally block them from integrations; or (B) allow a pilot-only reciprocity clause with strong carveouts plus a nominal credit. For the regional restriction, propose a limited non-solicit wording rather than exclusivity — or accept a 6-week exclusivity window instead of 6 months.

Need: an executive waiver for any deviation from our standard 'no-MFN' policy or from our partner exclusivity guardrails. Also need approval for up to 20% pilot discount (requested by sales).

Attaching our SOW draft and risk summary for context.

Diego Fernandez

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot agreement terms — reciprocity & regional restriction ask

Diego / Monica — thanks for the context, here's the recommended path and precise language we should propose back to VanguardAI: 

1) Reciprocity: DENY blanket MFN language. OFFER instead a 'pilot-term parity' clause: 
   - "For the duration of the Pilot (90 days), Redwood will honor the pricing and standard commercial terms offered to VanguardAI for the pilot SKU; such parity is expressly limited to the Pilot, non-precedential, and does not create ongoing MFN or pricing obligations beyond the Pilot term."
   - Include explicit carveouts for partner marketplace listings, publicly marketed discounts, and channel promotions.

2) Market restriction: REPLACE with a short non-solicit / market good-faith clause: 
   - "During the Pilot term, Redwood will not enter into a contract that contains an express exclusivity clause preventing VanguardAI from integrating our product in their EU segment. This shall not be interpreted as a broad restriction on Redwood's commercial activities and is limited to the scope of the Pilot and the specific commercial scope described in Appendix A."
   - If they insist on exclusivity, counter with 6 weeks and require a minimum spend threshold and executive sign-off.

3) Discount: APPROVE up to 15% pilot discount without exec signoff. Any discount >15% requires approval. The commercial ask for 20% triggers an exec-level concession.

4) Required conditions: NDA covering pilot data, SOC2 statement on data handling (redwood provided), and SOW with clear acceptance criteria and termination notice (30 days).

If you want to pursue the full waiver for MFN or the 6-month restriction, we need an Exec sign-off memo that outlines: deal economics, strategic rationale (why this customer matters), potential partner conflicts, and a sunset clause.

I'll draft the proposed clause text and the short memo for execs. Diego — please confirm if the strategic rationale is tied to the prospective dedicated deployment timelines; if so, include expected ARR projection.

Lauren Bishop
Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.inference | x4342

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.inference>

Subject: RE: Fwd: Pilot agreement terms — reciprocity & regional restriction ask

Diego / Lauren / Rishi — looping in Rishi for executive approval per Lauren's note. Rishi — short ask below, please respond with APPROVE / DENY / APPROVE-CONDITIONAL.

Summary: VanguardAI requests (1) pilot-scoped reciprocity (MFN-like) and (2) a 6-month regional exclusivity carveout during the POC. Pilot value ~ $28k; potential pipeline expansion into Dedicated later this FY (internal forecast $420k ARR if conversion). Sales requests 20% pilot discount (current threshold = 15%). Attachments: SOW draft and risk summary.

Decision options we're recommending to execs: 
A) Approve conditional waiver: allow pilot-term parity clause (explicitly timeboxed and non-precedential), replace full exclusivity with a 6-week limited market restraint + minimum spend $25k and inclusion of mutual exit rights; approve discount up to 15%.

B) Approve one-time exec concession: allow 20% discount + pilot-term parity limited to SKU; deny 6-month exclusivity and require 6-week cap instead.

C) Deny MFN and exclusivity; offer standard pilot terms and a commercial credit in lieu of parity.

Requested Exec action: Rishi, please reply with your choice and any additional guardrails (legal checklist / partner notification). If you approve A or B, we'll prepare the exec waiver memo and run it to Legal for redlines.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
